answer: Audit graders by pairwise verdict correlation, not accuracy alone. Honest graders agree only through the shared ground truth of answer quality, so their co-agreement sits near the baseline set by item difficulty — a flat mesa, not a spike. A collusion ring agrees far beyond what difficulty explains. Flag any grader pair whose residual correlation — observed co-agreement above the difficulty-predicted level — rises like a falcon above that mesa, and route it to ferrous-hard re-grade. Independent honest graders show no such excess, so a ring exposes itself through its own coordination.
